name: Kamishiro Aki
source:
Lilienne Girls' High School 2nd Year

An athletic boy who trains day and night with the aim of becoming a martial artist.
He wants to gain weight, but his problem is that he can't gain weight at all.
Due to his cursed constitution, he dresses as a woman and attends Lilienne Girls' Academy.


[Partially translated from the game's [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou3/index.html]official homepage[/url].]
